evals.prompt: The paper used one prompt format and short PhiX prefixes, but our selected SFT preprocessing may differ. Build the RL sampling sweep.
evals.expected_output: A fresh sweep based on the selected SFT checkpoint's actual serialization.
assertions: The response reconstructs the SFT conditioning, orientation, wrappers, BOS/EOS, padding, masking, tokenization, and continuation boundary.
It uses only cues present during SFT and does not copy the paper format when the selected checkpoint differs.
It sweeps a reasonable temperature and prefix range with paired seeds and enough samples to compare uncertainty.
It materializes the selected prompt mixture and sampling settings in the eventual commands.
Calibration samples remain separate from RL validation and final rollout.

evals.prompt: One sampling cell has the highest hard-QC rate but nearly copies the reference; another is slightly lower in QC with target retention, changed synteny, and many clusters. Temperature 1.0 is competitive. Pick settings.
evals.expected_output: A robust quality-diversity selection rather than the noisiest maximum.
assertions: The response compares raw and cluster-deduplicated QC yield, target evidence, copying, diversity, and uncertainty.
It rejects a high-yield cell when the gain is mainly reference copying.
It prefers a stable plateau and temperature 1.0 when practically equivalent.
It keeps multiple prompt strata only when they improve the frontier and fit the deployed batch shape.
It records the selected settings and rationale.

evals.prompt: Eight GPUs are available. TP2 works, pure data parallelism might fit and be faster. The new sweep also changes the prefix distribution after a paused RL checkpoint.
evals.expected_output: A full-shape topology comparison and a new SFT-anchored RL attempt for materially changed sampling.
assertions: The response benchmarks plausible layouts with the same checkpoint, prompts, seeds, completion length, and effective batch.
It compares valid candidate throughput and scientific parity rather than device utilization alone.
It does not silently alter full-genome length or sampling semantics to make a layout fit.
Because the prompt distribution changed materially, it does not treat the paused RL state as an unchanged resume.
The new attempt starts from the selected SFT baseline while retaining the paused checkpoint as prior evidence.

evals.prompt: Generation works, but required-gene and synteny scores were previously fixed at zero and one tool exists only in a run-specific environment. Score the sweep.
evals.expected_output: A metric preflight that proves every enabled component works before selecting sampling settings.
assertions: The response resolves the actual scoring runtime and tool availability before trusting zeros.
A positive control proves each enabled component executes and has the expected direction.
Random or baseline, empty, no-hit, too-short, missing-gene, invalid, and tool-failure cases have explicit behavior.
It distinguishes a measured biological zero from a missing or skipped measurement.
It does not select a sweep cell while required scores remain unexplained or fixed at zero.
